audit.why: The owner is addressed as "you", so any third-person pronoun refers to the enemy, Leona.
audit.corrected: Fixed "his"->"her" in loading, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[2].t (no report-cap on these, they're not report[] entries), and report[10].t (within the two-report-edit cap).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side says Leona wins Levels 1-5 then Skill for 6/1st item/2+ items, contradicting content win[]/whys[] which say Skill/even through Levels 1-5, Leona ahead at 6/1st item, Sona ahead at 2+ items.
audit.why: Leona cannot fully chain her lockup (Zenith Blade into Shield of Daybreak) before level 6 — Solar Flare is what turns the chain unmissable, matching the content layer's grounded reasoning.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-3].side to Skill and phases[4-5].side to Leona to match win[]; rewrote whys off the shared template.

audit.why: Leona's real spike is Solar Flare (R) at 6 plus her first engage item — reflected in the corrected chart instead of levels 1-5.
